name: Jasper Kell
want: get as far from Missouri as a wagon will take him, with money in his pocket
secret: He rode with a guerrilla band in the war and was at the burning of Lawrence; he is wanted in Kansas under his real name.
voice: Easy, joking, a Missouri drawl that hardens when crossed.
description: A hired driver for the Brandts, good with mules and cards. Some in the company like him a great deal; some watch him.
appearance: Handsome and unshaven, a cavalry pistol worn low, a Missouri slouch hat.
